d:
Ostreliyan kriket men sendpepar get ka jin ek bar phir botal se bahar aa gaya hai. is bar vajah bani hai ek kitab. ye kitab likhi hai ostreliya ke purv kriketar usman khvaja ne. vivad itna barh gaya ki ostreliyan kriket tim ke maujuda kaiptan pait kamins ko midiya ke samne aana para. aakhir usman khvaja ki kitab men aisa kya likha hai, pait kamins ne midiya ke samne ise lekar kya kaha aur usman khvaja ke samarthan men kaun sa kriketar aaya? janie sabkuchh is vidiyo ke zarie.
Vidiyoh navin negi aur aamra aamir
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
